R11 a wrong fact is corrected forward: withdrawPersonFact refuses NO_REASON and NO_SUCH_FACT, and NO_BY with no stamp, keeps the fact and marks it withdrawn with who, when and why; a repeat answers already
R12 (K5148) expunge of an id that answers no person fact, claim, tie or link is refused PERSON_ITEM_NOT_HELD, this module's own code and its own sentence, not plan-work's NO_SUCH_ITEM
R12 (K5148) the person read answers removed: [{ground, at, by}], one per tombstone of the person's facts, never the value, to every viewer who may read the person; a withdrawn fact is not removed

R12 expunge removes the value of a PFA-, IDC-, MTI- or source link and leaves a tombstone {id, ground, at, by}, only on unlawful, confidential, court_order (naming the order) or lawful_demand of a kind the active profiles list; another ground EXPUNGE_GROUND_REFUSED naming the grounds and the correction act; an unlisted kind DEMAND_KIND_UNLISTED; only an administrator; no read answers the removed value
R12: personRemoved hands on the real person read after an administrator's removal on a court order: the marker {ground, at, by} and no value

R13 each read answers over the identity cluster as the viewer sees it, stating the cluster and its state, each item naming the member it is held on; an undetermined cluster answers each item with its own member and joins nothing across the not_same_as

R14 peopleOf given no services reaches the real modules on the same host (K1563 (1)); personAt reads a holds line stated current through a day (lines R21) as held on or before that day and undetermined after it, and a line whose bound cache is stale as undetermined with its owner's reason, never as current

R14 personAt refuses NO_ENTITY and NO_DATE and answers names and life facts valid at the date, posts held then with capacity, the duties binding the person then as obligor, each with validity, grade and citation; an item whose validity does not settle the date is listed undetermined with the reason, never as current

R15 careerOf answers every holds line of the cluster in validity order with capacity, title as written (lines' title, null when not stated, never composed), bounds, grade and citation; credentialsOf the educated_at and credentialed_by lines, each credential with its issuer's scheme identifier as entities holds it under a scheme the active profiles name for the issuer's kind, else null with why; interestsOf the owns_interest_in lines and the money where the person is payee of income or a gift or payer of a contribution

R16 statementsOf answers each member's statements and acts (decider, signatory, implementer, author) merged in events' order, three-valued: two events whose order the record does not settle are answered as such, never placed
R17 every read bounds each list at 500 items in its stated order with truncated per list by reading one past, and never answers a count of a truncated list as whole

R18 staffingAt answers, for an organisation and its parts at a date, the persons holding a holds line to it then, and beside them each registered roster source's answer with its level, or 'held as a table, not read'; roster rows are never copied into lines

R19 registerRosterSource takes one source per module, refused through membership's listenerRefusal (LISTENER_MALFORMED, LISTENER_DECLARED); sources are asked in the modules' total order; a source that throws is named as failed and the read still answers

R2 the grade is earned from the basis, never stated: identifier A only with one scheme identifier held on both and valid at both cited dates; corroborated_name B only with a cited line on each valid at both dates; name C; testimony D; a failed condition refused IDENTITY_GRADE_UNEARNED naming it; why says 'claimed the same person, grade X, because …', never 'is the same person'

R20 a member declares only their own tie (MTI-), to a registered entity, of kind employer, relative, business or other, with a note and the attribution level they choose; by is the stamp and no field names another member; a machine is refused; seen only by its member and administrators, any other viewer answered exactly as for no tie; tiesConcerning answers the member's ties to given entities with their levels
R20: tiesConcerningRefusal hands on the real tiesConcerning with a bad argument: no member named gives the empty list, not a refusal; a member read with no viewer and no argument at all still answers

R21 (K5148) the read by source takes source_id (source is a door stamp the door deletes from every query), reads the link to a listed member and none to another; a read naming neither source_id nor person is refused, never answered as empty

R21 a source is linked to a registered person with evidence and a non-empty sight list (NO_SIGHT_LIST); only the listed members read it; every other viewer, every other read and the export answer exactly as if no link were held; being a source is never stated by personAt or any other person read; a later link of the pair governs and the one it replaced is kept (N617)

R22 a check (CHK-) is data-defined: line kinds, event roles or money kinds at each end, a hop bound of at most two through related_to or associate_of, a denominator; the shipped checks include the revolving door; a member may add one; one naming a hypothesis is HYPOTHESIS_NOT_A_FACT; any check may be switched off per project by a member of it; a change is a new version and earlier versions are kept
R22, R24: checkResults hands on the real listChecks and checkResults over an empty record: the shipped check listed, gated with no result shown; no viewer is refused

R23 evaluateChecks evaluates every switched-on check over the held record within its budget, writing each match to the checks' own table with its cited derivation and denominator, never to a person's or entity's row; it answers {evaluated, remaining} and resumes where it stopped; a computation
R23: evaluateChecksAnswers hands on the real evaluateChecks: the one person the record holds evaluated, nothing remaining; a zero budget is answered too

R24 (T35; DEC-131) each answered result, wherever it reaches a member (op=interestchecks, and what R25's listeners are told), carries mark 'Hint · machine work' beside label 'Noticed', its detail beginning with that mark and calling it a hint, never a signal; label, layer, by and every key stay

R24 a machine check version's results are answered only once its gate is recorded by an administrator (NO_GOLD_SET; a rate outside 0–1 refused) at a false-alarm rate at most 20%; until then {gated: true, reason} and no result; each result labelled the machine's, layer hypothesis, 'Noticed', with its derivation and denominator; a member's own check shows at once; a gate measured again governs and the one it replaced is kept (N617)

R25 a result whose derivation rests on any row the viewer may not see is withheld whole and not counted; onCheckResult registrations (R19's rule) are told of each new gated-open result once, for notice-producers

R26 people registers as the owner of same_as, not_same_as and unsure; neighbours presents each visible unwithdrawn claim as one evidentiary hop with the claim's evidence and grade; it passes connection-grammar's owner-conformance battery
R27 peopleOps publishes one route arm per op above, each answering what its service answers, its viewer from the query and its acts' arguments from the body
R28 linked, never merged: no act of people changes an entities row, alias or resolution, and two persons stay two ids whatever claims join them
R29 no judgment on a person: no table holds a score, rank, suspicion or conflict field, and no outward text uses 'knows', 'conflict', 'suspicious' or 'most connected'
R3 a machine may record only an identifier claim from source-native data with identifiers at both ends; any other machine claim is MACHINE_CLAIM_REFUSED
R30 one home per fact: this module holds no post, membership, credential, interest, tie, statement or amount; a read gathers them from their owners and stores nothing of them

R31 sight: the registry is group-wide; a fact follows its document's visibility; identity claims, testimony and check results inside a project the viewer may not see are not answered and not counted; ties and the source link take their own narrowest sight; every withheld item answers exactly as an absent one
R32 no place is named in this module's behaviour, defaults or outward text; schemes, filing officers and demand kinds are profile data

R33 every table is declared explicitly through record-core's declareTable with the classes the requirement names: person_facts export yes, its contact table never, identity_claims yes with sight by project, member_ties never (K1490), source_person_links never, the checks and their results admin-only, N617's histories source_person_link_history never and interest_check_gate_history admin-only, the cluster derived-rebuildable; rows naming a bundle are keyed to it

R34 sourceLinkSight(person) is a synchronous internal read, never an op: null when no link to the person is held (and for an unregistered or malformed id), else the members every held link to that person admits (the intersection of their sight lists); it takes no viewer, writes nothing and never throws

R35 onChecksChanged takes one registration per module (membership's listenerRefusal); after a check is defined, given a new version, or switched on or off in a project, fn({check, project}) is called once, after the act's transaction; a throwing fn never undoes the act; the notice writes nothing

R36 limit is clamped to 1–500 (default 100), truncated by reading one past; refusals VIEWER_MISSING, NO_SHA and EXTENT_MALFORMED each write nothing, the first and last as {ok: false, refused, code, reason, why} with no catalogue row (K2116); it writes nothing and never throws
R36 never an item: the protected source link (R21: the read answers exactly as if none were held), a member's tie (R20) and an interest-check result (R23)

R36 recordedBy answers events R49's shape over person facts citing an extent of the capture (kind person_fact, field citation) and identity claims whose evidence cites one (kind identity_claim, field evidence), each naming who recorded it as stamped (a member, or class:<cls> for the machine) and this module's instant, a fact recorded from a found extent named with its member

R36 sight is R31's: a fact citing a capture the viewer may not see is neither answered nor counted, the capture answering items: [] as one not held; a claim made inside a project the viewer may not see is neither answered nor counted; an address or contact fact only as R10 admits

R36 with extent, only rows whose extent stands same, narrower or wider to it (content.extentRelation(extent, row's extent)) are items, relation that answer; without it every row citing the capture, relation null; items in the order of their canonical extent, then record, then field
R36 withdrawn is true for a fact withdrawn (R11) or a claim withdrawn (R4), the row still answered; an expunged row (R12) is never an item
R37 a malformed argument is refused naming it, and nothing is read
R37 counts only what the viewer may see: a project hidden from the viewer counts as nothing and is never named (control: the same mentions counted for a participant)
R37 each filter: q (a name, a name they are also known by, an office held), show, office (a body), namedIn (any, mine, one project), since (30, 90, 365 days)
R37 pages by cursor, at most limit rows, with truncated: paging to the end never skips or repeats a row

R37 peopleDirectory answers the people and organisations the record follows (persons and the organisation kinds; never an office, any other kind or the group's members), each row {entity, kind, name, today, documents, questions, projects, newest_added, mine}
R37 the order: named in the viewer's projects first, then newest added first, then by entity id; following and in_your_projects are totals over the filter
R37 writes nothing, and op=peopledirectory answers what the read answers, its viewer stamped in the query

R38 an organisation row answers in today, beside note, note_by (the entity's declared_by as entities holds it) and machine (true exactly when that author is a machine identity): a body setup's seeding declared answers machine: true; control: a body a member registered answers that member's stamp and machine: false; a person row is unchanged

R39 personAt answers claims: every unwithdrawn identity claim the viewer may see with an end in the cluster it states, same_as, not_same_as and unsure alike, each {claim_id, a, b, kind, grade, why, by, at} as R1 and R2 answer it, ordered by at then claim_id; withdrawIdentityClaim with a listed id leaves the rest; control: a claim made in a project hidden from the viewer is absent and uncounted

R23: evaluateChecksAnswers hands on the real evaluateChecks: the one person the record holds evaluated, nothing remaining; a zero budget is answered too
R20: tiesConcerningRefusal hands on the real tiesConcerning with a bad argument: no member named gives the empty list, not a refusal; a member read with no viewer and no argument at all still answers

R1 claimIdentity refuses in order NO_ENDS, SELF_CLAIM, NO_SUCH_ENTITY naming the end, NOT_A_PERSON naming the end, UNKNOWN_CLAIM_KIND naming the three, UNKNOWN_BASIS, NO_EVIDENCE, NO_NOTE, IDENTITY_GRADE_UNEARNED; each writes nothing; otherwise one IDC- claim answered {ok, claim_id, kind, grade, why, at}

R2 the grade is earned from the basis, never stated: identifier A only with one scheme identifier held on both and valid at both cited dates; corroborated_name B only with a cited line on each valid at both dates; name C; testimony D; a failed condition refused IDENTITY_GRADE_UNEARNED naming it; why says 'claimed the same person, grade X, because …', never 'is the same person'
R3 a machine may record only an identifier claim from source-native data with identifiers at both ends; any other machine claim is MACHINE_CLAIM_REFUSED

R4 a claim is never edited or deleted: withdrawIdentityClaim refuses NO_REASON and NO_SUCH_CLAIM, and NO_BY with no stamp, a repeat answers already, the withdrawn claim links nothing, and no entities row, alias or resolution moves

R5 identityOf answers the transitive same_as cluster the viewer may see, each link with claim, grade and why; undetermined when a not_same_as joins two members (naming it); unsure listed and joining nothing; an unregistered id found:false; bounded at 500 members with truncated

R6 the cluster is a derived cache rebuilt in each claim's and withdrawal's transaction, equal to its rebuild, and read fail-closed: a stale or differing cache answers undetermined with the reason, never a stale cluster

R26 people registers as the owner of same_as, not_same_as and unsure; neighbours presents each visible unwithdrawn claim as one evidentiary hop with the claim's evidence and grade; it passes connection-grammar's owner-conformance battery
R28 linked, never merged: no act of people changes an entities row, alias or resolution, and two persons stay two ids whatever claims join them
R1 an organization pair is claimed same_as, read back through identityOf and the claims personAt answers, and listed by samePersonCandidates
R1 the kinds a claim can join are the person and the organisation kinds: a body pair and a movement pair are claimed, an office is NOT_A_PERSON
R1 a claim across kinds is refused KIND_MISMATCH naming both kinds and writes nothing (control: the same pair of one kind is claimed); R7 candidates are of the entity's own kind
R1 a person pair is claimed and its candidates answered as before, and a person fact stays a person's only (R9)

R9 an institution, body or movement records name, address and contact facts, read back by personAt and withdrawn as a person's; its birth, death and locality are refused NOT_A_PERSON writing nothing (control: a person's facts unchanged)
R9 an organisation's other refusals are a person's: an unknown kind, no value, no citation, a machine's address (R10)

R13 each read answers over the identity cluster as the viewer sees it, stating the cluster and its state, each item naming the member it is held on; an undetermined cluster answers each item with its own member and joins nothing across the not_same_as

R14 personAt refuses NO_ENTITY and NO_DATE and answers names and life facts valid at the date, posts held then with capacity, the duties binding the person then as obligor, each with validity, grade and citation; an item whose validity does not settle the date is listed undetermined with the reason, never as current

R15 careerOf answers every holds line of the cluster in validity order with capacity, title as written (lines' title, null when not stated, never composed), bounds, grade and citation; credentialsOf the educated_at and credentialed_by lines, each credential with its issuer's scheme identifier as entities holds it under a scheme the active profiles name for the issuer's kind, else null with why; interestsOf the owns_interest_in lines and the money where the person is payee of income or a gift or payer of a contribution

R16 statementsOf answers each member's statements and acts (decider, signatory, implementer, author) merged in events' order, three-valued: two events whose order the record does not settle are answered as such, never placed
R17 every read bounds each list at 500 items in its stated order with truncated per list by reading one past, and never answers a count of a truncated list as whole

R18 staffingAt answers, for an organisation and its parts at a date, the persons holding a holds line to it then, and beside them each registered roster source's answer with its level, or 'held as a table, not read'; roster rows are never copied into lines

R19 registerRosterSource takes one source per module, refused through membership's listenerRefusal (LISTENER_MALFORMED, LISTENER_DECLARED); sources are asked in the modules' total order; a source that throws is named as failed and the read still answers
M-P5 a person read at 50,000 lines answers within the response budget (connection-grammar's time budget)

R14 peopleOf given no services reaches the real modules on the same host (K1563 (1)); personAt reads a holds line stated current through a day (lines R21) as held on or before that day and undetermined after it, and a line whose bound cache is stale as undetermined with its owner's reason, never as current

R39 personAt answers claims: every unwithdrawn identity claim the viewer may see with an end in the cluster it states, same_as, not_same_as and unsure alike, each {claim_id, a, b, kind, grade, why, by, at} as R1 and R2 answer it, ordered by at then claim_id; withdrawIdentityClaim with a listed id leaves the rest; control: a claim made in a project hidden from the viewer is absent and uncounted
R39 personAt's claims are bounded at 1,000 (R5's bound) with claims_truncated by reading one past; a claim hidden from the viewer is not counted toward it (control: the participant reads one past)
R43 each claim row personAt answers carries basis, as stored and as identityOf serves it, stored basis

R44 personAt answers the person's withdrawn facts the viewer may see, each marked withdrawn with who, when and why, apart from the facts not withdrawn, which are answered as before; control: a withdrawn fact on a capture the viewer may not see is absent, and an expunged fact is not listed

R36 recordedBy answers events R49's shape over person facts citing an extent of the capture (kind person_fact, field citation) and identity claims whose evidence cites one (kind identity_claim, field evidence), each naming who recorded it as stamped (a member, or class:<cls> for the machine) and this module's instant, a fact recorded from a found extent named with its member
R36 withdrawn is true for a fact withdrawn (R11) or a claim withdrawn (R4), the row still answered; an expunged row (R12) is never an item

R36 sight is R31's: a fact citing a capture the viewer may not see is neither answered nor counted, the capture answering items: [] as one not held; a claim made inside a project the viewer may not see is neither answered nor counted; an address or contact fact only as R10 admits
R36 never an item: the protected source link (R21: the read answers exactly as if none were held), a member's tie (R20) and an interest-check result (R23)

R36 with extent, only rows whose extent stands same, narrower or wider to it (content.extentRelation(extent, row's extent)) are items, relation that answer; without it every row citing the capture, relation null; items in the order of their canonical extent, then record, then field

R36 limit is clamped to 1–500 (default 100), truncated by reading one past; refusals VIEWER_MISSING, NO_SHA and EXTENT_MALFORMED each write nothing, the first and last as {ok: false, refused, code, reason, why} with no catalogue row (K2116); it writes nothing and never throws

R20 a member declares only their own tie (MTI-), to a registered entity, of kind employer, relative, business or other, with a note and the attribution level they choose; by is the stamp and no field names another member; a machine is refused; seen only by its member and administrators, any other viewer answered exactly as for no tie; tiesConcerning answers the member's ties to given entities with their levels

R21 a source is linked to a registered person with evidence and a non-empty sight list (NO_SIGHT_LIST); only the listed members read it; every other viewer, every other read and the export answer exactly as if no link were held; being a source is never stated by personAt or any other person read; a later link of the pair governs and the one it replaced is kept (N617)

R34 sourceLinkSight(person) is a synchronous internal read, never an op: null when no link to the person is held (and for an unregistered or malformed id), else the members every held link to that person admits (the intersection of their sight lists); it takes no viewer, writes nothing and never throws

R31 sight: the registry is group-wide; a fact follows its document's visibility; identity claims, testimony and check results inside a project the viewer may not see are not answered and not counted; ties and the source link take their own narrowest sight; every withheld item answers exactly as an absent one

R21 (K5148) the read by source takes source_id (source is a door stamp the door deletes from every query), reads the link to a listed member and none to another; a read naming neither source_id nor person is refused, never answered as empty
R40 a fact stating no validity answers {key: people.why.validity_stated, vars: {}} and word of it equals the key's words; control: a fact with a validity valid at the date is in no undetermined list
R40 an owner that states the validity undetermined with no reason is answered people.why.owner_settle_validity; one that gives a reason is passed on exactly as it answers it
R40 a holds line stated current through a day answers {key: lines.why.stated_current_through, vars: {why, day}} after that day

R40 a cluster with a not_same_as claim answers people.why.claim_joins_two with {apart} the claim id, in identityOf and in each read's cluster; a cache stale or differing answers its own key; no answer's why is a string

R40 a hub answer of the identity kinds, at connection-grammar's string contract, is the sentence word reads for people.why.person_end_identity with {hub}, and why_key stands beside it

R8 M-P6 on the synthetic same-name fixture (two Michael Houstons and a thousand others): among offered candidates agreeing on every compared field, the share that are different people is at most 0.5%
R42 people declares identityclaim: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R42 people declares withdrawidentityclaim: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R42 people declares recordpersonfact: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R42 people declares personexpunge: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R42 people declares declaretie: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R42 people declares withdrawtie: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R42 people declares sourcepersonlink: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused

R9 recordPersonFact records one PFA- fact (kind closed: name, birth, death, locality, address, contact; the value as the document states it; a validity; a citation), refusing in order NO_SUCH_ENTITY, NOT_A_PERSON, UNKNOWN_FACT_KIND, NO_VALUE, NO_CITATION, BAD_VALIDITY naming the bound

R10 an address or contact is recorded only by a member's act (a machine write is CONTACT_NOT_IMPORTED), held in a table of export class never, answered only to a viewer who may see the citing capture, and always publishable: false

R11 a wrong fact is corrected forward: withdrawPersonFact refuses NO_REASON and NO_SUCH_FACT, and NO_BY with no stamp, keeps the fact and marks it withdrawn with who, when and why; a repeat answers already

R12 expunge removes the value of a PFA-, IDC-, MTI- or source link and leaves a tombstone {id, ground, at, by}, only on unlawful, confidential, court_order (naming the order) or lawful_demand of a kind the active profiles list; another ground EXPUNGE_GROUND_REFUSED naming the grounds and the correction act; an unlisted kind DEMAND_KIND_UNLISTED; only an administrator; no read answers the removed value

R33 every table is declared explicitly through record-core's declareTable with the classes the requirement names: person_facts export yes, its contact table never, identity_claims yes with sight by project, member_ties never (K1490), source_person_links never, the checks and their results admin-only, N617's histories source_person_link_history never and interest_check_gate_history admin-only, the cluster derived-rebuildable; rows naming a bundle are keyed to it

R9 (T35) the citation may be an extent a find answered (retrieval R73's match: its capture_sha and extent), taken exactly as any other extent: the same refusals, the grade of its capture, and the sight of its capture

R9 (T35) recordPersonFact takes an optional question, an inquiry the record holds and the actor may see, refused QUESTION_NOT_HELD after BAD_VALIDITY (absent and unseen alike); kept beside the fact unchanged and answered with it by every read that answers the fact to a viewer who may see that inquiry, withheld as absent (null) from any other; a fact recorded without one answers question: null
R12 (K5148) the person read answers removed: [{ground, at, by}], one per tombstone of the person's facts, never the value, to every viewer who may read the person; a withdrawn fact is not removed
R12 (K5148) expunge of an id that answers no person fact, claim, tie or link is refused PERSON_ITEM_NOT_HELD, this module's own code and its own sentence, not plan-work's NO_SUCH_ITEM
R22, R24: checkResults hands on the real listChecks and checkResults over an empty record: the shipped check listed, gated with no result shown; no viewer is refused
R23: evaluateChecksAnswers hands on the real evaluateChecks: the one person the record holds evaluated, nothing remaining; a zero budget is answered too
R20: tiesConcerningRefusal hands on the real tiesConcerning with a bad argument: no member named gives the empty list, not a refusal; a member read with no viewer and no argument at all still answers
R12: personRemoved hands on the real person read after an administrator's removal on a court order: the marker {ground, at, by} and no value

R1 claimIdentity refuses in order NO_ENDS, SELF_CLAIM, NO_SUCH_ENTITY naming the end, NOT_A_PERSON naming the end, UNKNOWN_CLAIM_KIND naming the three, UNKNOWN_BASIS, NO_EVIDENCE, NO_NOTE, IDENTITY_GRADE_UNEARNED; each writes nothing; otherwise one IDC- claim answered {ok, claim_id, kind, grade, why, at}

R2 the grade is earned from the basis, never stated: identifier A only with one scheme identifier held on both and valid at both cited dates; corroborated_name B only with a cited line on each valid at both dates; name C; testimony D; a failed condition refused IDENTITY_GRADE_UNEARNED naming it; why says 'claimed the same person, grade X, because …', never 'is the same person'
R3 a machine may record only an identifier claim from source-native data with identifiers at both ends; any other machine claim is MACHINE_CLAIM_REFUSED

R4 a claim is never edited or deleted: withdrawIdentityClaim refuses NO_REASON and NO_SUCH_CLAIM, and NO_BY with no stamp, a repeat answers already, the withdrawn claim links nothing, and no entities row, alias or resolution moves

R5 identityOf answers the transitive same_as cluster the viewer may see, each link with claim, grade and why; undetermined when a not_same_as joins two members (naming it); unsure listed and joining nothing; an unregistered id found:false; bounded at 500 members with truncated

R6 the cluster is a derived cache rebuilt in each claim's and withdrawal's transaction, equal to its rebuild, and read fail-closed: a stale or differing cache answers undetermined with the reason, never a stale cluster

R26 people registers as the owner of same_as, not_same_as and unsure; neighbours presents each visible unwithdrawn claim as one evidentiary hop with the claim's evidence and grade; it passes connection-grammar's owner-conformance battery
R28 linked, never merged: no act of people changes an entities row, alias or resolution, and two persons stay two ids whatever claims join them
R1 an organization pair is claimed same_as, read back through identityOf and the claims personAt answers, and listed by samePersonCandidates
R1 the kinds a claim can join are the person and the organisation kinds: a body pair and a movement pair are claimed, an office is NOT_A_PERSON
R1 a claim across kinds is refused KIND_MISMATCH naming both kinds and writes nothing (control: the same pair of one kind is claimed); R7 candidates are of the entity's own kind
R1 a person pair is claimed and its candidates answered as before, and a person fact stays a person's only (R9)

R9 an institution, body or movement records name, address and contact facts, read back by personAt and withdrawn as a person's; its birth, death and locality are refused NOT_A_PERSON writing nothing (control: a person's facts unchanged)
R9 an organisation's other refusals are a person's: an unknown kind, no value, no citation, a machine's address (R10)

R13 each read answers over the identity cluster as the viewer sees it, stating the cluster and its state, each item naming the member it is held on; an undetermined cluster answers each item with its own member and joins nothing across the not_same_as

R14 personAt refuses NO_ENTITY and NO_DATE and answers names and life facts valid at the date, posts held then with capacity, the duties binding the person then as obligor, each with validity, grade and citation; an item whose validity does not settle the date is listed undetermined with the reason, never as current

R15 careerOf answers every holds line of the cluster in validity order with capacity, title as written (lines' title, null when not stated, never composed), bounds, grade and citation; credentialsOf the educated_at and credentialed_by lines, each credential with its issuer's scheme identifier as entities holds it under a scheme the active profiles name for the issuer's kind, else null with why; interestsOf the owns_interest_in lines and the money where the person is payee of income or a gift or payer of a contribution

R16 statementsOf answers each member's statements and acts (decider, signatory, implementer, author) merged in events' order, three-valued: two events whose order the record does not settle are answered as such, never placed
R17 every read bounds each list at 500 items in its stated order with truncated per list by reading one past, and never answers a count of a truncated list as whole

R18 staffingAt answers, for an organisation and its parts at a date, the persons holding a holds line to it then, and beside them each registered roster source's answer with its level, or 'held as a table, not read'; roster rows are never copied into lines

R19 registerRosterSource takes one source per module, refused through membership's listenerRefusal (LISTENER_MALFORMED, LISTENER_DECLARED); sources are asked in the modules' total order; a source that throws is named as failed and the read still answers
M-P5 a person read at 50,000 lines answers within the response budget (connection-grammar's time budget)

R14 peopleOf given no services reaches the real modules on the same host (K1563 (1)); personAt reads a holds line stated current through a day (lines R21) as held on or before that day and undetermined after it, and a line whose bound cache is stale as undetermined with its owner's reason, never as current

R39 personAt answers claims: every unwithdrawn identity claim the viewer may see with an end in the cluster it states, same_as, not_same_as and unsure alike, each {claim_id, a, b, kind, grade, why, by, at} as R1 and R2 answer it, ordered by at then claim_id; withdrawIdentityClaim with a listed id leaves the rest; control: a claim made in a project hidden from the viewer is absent and uncounted
R39 personAt's claims are bounded at 1,000 (R5's bound) with claims_truncated by reading one past; a claim hidden from the viewer is not counted toward it (control: the participant reads one past)
R43 each claim row personAt answers carries basis, as stored and as identityOf serves it, stored basis

R44 personAt answers the person's withdrawn facts the viewer may see, each marked withdrawn with who, when and why, apart from the facts not withdrawn, which are answered as before; control: a withdrawn fact on a capture the viewer may not see is absent, and an expunged fact is not listed

R36 recordedBy answers events R49's shape over person facts citing an extent of the capture (kind person_fact, field citation) and identity claims whose evidence cites one (kind identity_claim, field evidence), each naming who recorded it as stamped (a member, or class:<cls> for the machine) and this module's instant, a fact recorded from a found extent named with its member
R36 withdrawn is true for a fact withdrawn (R11) or a claim withdrawn (R4), the row still answered; an expunged row (R12) is never an item

R36 sight is R31's: a fact citing a capture the viewer may not see is neither answered nor counted, the capture answering items: [] as one not held; a claim made inside a project the viewer may not see is neither answered nor counted; an address or contact fact only as R10 admits
R36 never an item: the protected source link (R21: the read answers exactly as if none were held), a member's tie (R20) and an interest-check result (R23)

R36 with extent, only rows whose extent stands same, narrower or wider to it (content.extentRelation(extent, row's extent)) are items, relation that answer; without it every row citing the capture, relation null; items in the order of their canonical extent, then record, then field

R36 limit is clamped to 1–500 (default 100), truncated by reading one past; refusals VIEWER_MISSING, NO_SHA and EXTENT_MALFORMED each write nothing, the first and last as {ok: false, refused, code, reason, why} with no catalogue row (K2116); it writes nothing and never throws

R20 a member declares only their own tie (MTI-), to a registered entity, of kind employer, relative, business or other, with a note and the attribution level they choose; by is the stamp and no field names another member; a machine is refused; seen only by its member and administrators, any other viewer answered exactly as for no tie; tiesConcerning answers the member's ties to given entities with their levels

R21 a source is linked to a registered person with evidence and a non-empty sight list (NO_SIGHT_LIST); only the listed members read it; every other viewer, every other read and the export answer exactly as if no link were held; being a source is never stated by personAt or any other person read; a later link of the pair governs and the one it replaced is kept (N617)

R34 sourceLinkSight(person) is a synchronous internal read, never an op: null when no link to the person is held (and for an unregistered or malformed id), else the members every held link to that person admits (the intersection of their sight lists); it takes no viewer, writes nothing and never throws

R31 sight: the registry is group-wide; a fact follows its document's visibility; identity claims, testimony and check results inside a project the viewer may not see are not answered and not counted; ties and the source link take their own narrowest sight; every withheld item answers exactly as an absent one

R21 (K5148) the read by source takes source_id (source is a door stamp the door deletes from every query), reads the link to a listed member and none to another; a read naming neither source_id nor person is refused, never answered as empty
R40 a fact stating no validity answers {key: people.why.validity_stated, vars: {}} and word of it equals the key's words; control: a fact with a validity valid at the date is in no undetermined list
R40 an owner that states the validity undetermined with no reason is answered people.why.owner_settle_validity; one that gives a reason is passed on exactly as it answers it
R40 a holds line stated current through a day answers {key: lines.why.stated_current_through, vars: {why, day}} after that day

R40 a cluster with a not_same_as claim answers people.why.claim_joins_two with {apart} the claim id, in identityOf and in each read's cluster; a cache stale or differing answers its own key; no answer's why is a string

R40 a duty whose in-force answer is unsettled with no reason is answered people.why.whether_source_force; a pair statementsOf cannot order is answered people.why.record_settle_order, or the owner's reason exactly when it gives one
R40 a hub answer of the identity kinds, at connection-grammar's string contract, is the sentence word reads for people.why.person_end_identity with {hub}, and why_key stands beside it

R40 a claim whose validity does not settle the date is a hop marked undetermined, its why the owner's {key, vars} as civil-time answers it, which connection-grammar's contract judges (R6); the registry accepts it

outside.waitsOn: duties: the item in its interface files
tests: R7 candidates share a name's fold or a scheme identifier, are explained field by field (names, identifiers, posts, life facts: agrees, differs or absent with the rows compared), carry no score or rank, are ordered by entity id, bounded 1–200 (default 50) with truncated, write nothing and say they are not claims
R8 M-P6 on the synthetic same-name fixture (two Michael Houstons and a thousand others): among offered candidates agreeing on every compared field, the share that are different people is at most 0.5%

R22 a check (CHK-) is data-defined: line kinds, event roles or money kinds at each end, a hop bound of at most two through related_to or associate_of, a denominator; the shipped checks include the revolving door; a member may add one; one naming a hypothesis is HYPOTHESIS_NOT_A_FACT; any check may be switched off per project by a member of it; a change is a new version and earlier versions are kept

R23 evaluateChecks evaluates every switched-on check over the held record within its budget, writing each match to the checks' own table with its cited derivation and denominator, never to a person's or entity's row; it answers {evaluated, remaining} and resumes where it stopped; a computation

tests: R7 candidates share a name's fold or a scheme identifier, are explained field by field (names, identifiers, posts, life facts: agrees, differs or absent with the rows compared), carry no score or rank, are ordered by entity id, bounded 1–200 (default 50) with truncated, write nothing and say they are not claims
R8 M-P6 on the synthetic same-name fixture (two Michael Houstons and a thousand others): among offered candidates agreeing on every compared field, the share that are different people is at most 0.5%

R22 a check (CHK-) is data-defined: line kinds, event roles or money kinds at each end, a hop bound of at most two through related_to or associate_of, a denominator; the shipped checks include the revolving door; a member may add one; one naming a hypothesis is HYPOTHESIS_NOT_A_FACT; any check may be switched off per project by a member of it; a change is a new version and earlier versions are kept

R23 evaluateChecks evaluates every switched-on check over the held record within its budget, writing each match to the checks' own table with its cited derivation and denominator, never to a person's or entity's row; it answers {evaluated, remaining} and resumes where it stopped; a computation

R24 a machine check version's results are answered only once its gate is recorded by an administrator (NO_GOLD_SET; a rate outside 0–1 refused) at a false-alarm rate at most 20%; until then {gated: true, reason} and no result; each result labelled the machine's, layer hypothesis, 'Noticed', with its derivation and denominator; a member's own check shows at once; a gate measured again governs and the one it replaced is kept (N617)

R25 a result whose derivation rests on any row the viewer may not see is withheld whole and not counted; onCheckResult registrations (R19's rule) are told of each new gated-open result once, for notice-producers

R35 onChecksChanged takes one registration per module (membership's listenerRefusal); after a check is defined, given a new version, or switched on or off in a project, fn({check, project}) is called once, after the act's transaction; a throwing fn never undoes the act; the notice writes nothing

R24 (T35; DEC-131) each answered result, wherever it reaches a member (op=interestchecks, and what R25's listeners are told), carries mark 'Hint · machine work' beside label 'Noticed', its detail beginning with that mark and calling it a hint, never a signal; label, layer, by and every key stay
